description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimuli types used in a study, specifically relating to generative AI’s use in journalism. The chart contains seven slices, each representing a different type of stimuli. These are, moving clockwise from the top, Intra-agency news article (red, 0.7%), Press Release (yellow, 21.9%), Social Media Post (green, 1.5%), External News Article (dark green, 13.1%), Organizational Website (teal, 6.6%), Interview (blue, 10.2%), and Organizational Report (purple, 8.8%). Event Posting is also represented (grey, 8.8%). Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered in a descending fashion based on their proportional size, with Press Release being the largest and Intra-agency news article being the smallest. A legend is not present, but the chart title “Stimuli Type” is centered within the pie.
